problems.title: Fourier coefficients turn area into a quadratic expression
problems.statement_md: Let a planar width-$w$ support function be a finite Fourier sum $h=w/2+\sum_{k\text{ odd}}(a_k\cos k\theta+b_k\sin k\theta)$ with $h+h''\geq0$. Prove $A=\pi w^2/4-\frac\pi2\sum_{k\geq3,\,k\text{ odd}}(k^2-1)(a_k^2+b_k^2)$. Explain the role of the $k=1$ terms.
problems.hint_md: Fourier orthogonality eliminates cross terms. Differentiation multiplies the energy of the $k$th mode by $k^2$.

problems.title: Certifying convexity between sampled angles
problems.statement_md: Let $\rho=h+h''$ be a differentiable trigonometric polynomial, and suppose $|\rho'|\leq L$. At equally spaced grid angles with spacing $\Delta$, assume $\rho\geq\varepsilon$. Prove $\rho(\theta)\geq\varepsilon-L\Delta/2$ everywhere. Give a computable coefficient bound for $L$.
problems.hint_md: Every angle lies within half a grid spacing of a sampled angle. Bound the derivative using the amplitudes of the Fourier modes.

problems.title: Positive curvature samples can hide nonconvexity
problems.statement_md: For an even grid size $N\geq4$ and angles $\theta_j=2\pi j/N$, construct a trigonometric polynomial support candidate with constant antipodal sum one, such that $h+h''=1/2$ at every grid point but is negative somewhere between them.
problems.hint_md: Choose two odd frequencies at least three that agree on the grid. Their difference can vanish at every sample without vanishing between samples.

problems.title: Compute the Reuleaux triangle’s Cheeger constant
problems.statement_md: Using the explicit eroded regular-polygon area for $n=3$, implement bisection on $A(T_{-t})-\pi t^2=0$ in $[0,1-1/\sqrt3]$. Explain how an interval for $t$ gives an interval for $h_C(T)$.
problems.hint_md: Keep endpoints with opposite signs for the root equation. Remember that taking reciprocals reverses the order of positive endpoints.

problems.title: Check a spherical area computation using two helper points
problems.statement_md: For the geodesic triangle whose vertices are the three positive coordinate unit vectors, compute its area directly and by triangulating from $q=(1,1,1)/\sqrt3$. Repeat with $q'=(2,1,1)/\sqrt6$. Describe useful checks for a program summing Meissner face areas.
problems.hint_md: The coordinate triangle occupies one of eight equal octants. Use this independent area value to check both helper-point triangulations.

problems.title: Dimensionless quantities as debugging tests
problems.statement_md: If a planar constant-width body is rescaled by $a>0$, identify the invariant combinations of width $w$, area $A$, perimeter $P$, Cheeger constant $h_C$, first Dirichlet eigenvalue $\lambda_1$, and torsional rigidity $T=\int_Ku$ (with $-\Delta u=1$ in the interior and $u=0$ on the boundary). Give the analogous area and volume combinations in three dimensions.
problems.hint_md: Change variables $x=ay$ in the integrals. For torsion, also determine how the solution of $-\Delta u=1$ scales.
